offline_audit.method: Python stdlib, independent factoradic unranking and ID-indexed simultaneous transitions; recomputed fixture expectations, checked embedded output limb/order assertions, exact byte prefixes and raw stdout/stderr/exit hashes

full_paths: ones (historical evidence; do not duplicate without replay justification)
next_gate.replay: repeat a nontrivial full path, compare exact output and immutable inputs
next_gate.invalids: allocated semantic-invalid records and canonical BigInt violations; no physical invalid pointers
next_gate.mutants: actual unique source substitutions including old neighbor mapping defect; require failing specific numerical assertion, not timeout/parser fault
next_gate.limits: per full path 600 s and 2 GiB address space; retain actual exit/stdout/stderr and measure each; CI job budget must cover aggregate timeout
next_gate.audit: verify exact source/runtime pin, ZIP SHA/CRC, independent math, raw outputs, exits, and source mutant diffs before bounded acceptance
